name: Varga
title: Ore Broker
examine: Scales true to the grain, and an eye truer. Every barrow of deep ore crosses her counter before it sees daylight.
lines: Ore bought, ore sold, weighed in front of you. Nothing down here to distract a scale.
Bursar Odele takes my ledger up the stair every night. We have never disagreed by so much as a pebble.
Mithril? Adamant? Walk the galleries with your own pick. Starfall? Walk faster than the spider.
